Safety of the goods carried by theSafety of the goods carried by the
RailwaysRailways
*41. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that goods  carried
by the Railways which was over 88 per
cent in 1970s have come down to merely
40 per cent in late 1990s;
(b) if so, how far lack of safety of
carriages, pilferage of goods, spreading
corruption and ill-maintenance of rail-
wagons and other equipments  are
responsible for the  less earnings of the
Railways from goods and freight; and
(c) what additional safety measures and
other steps including raids are being taken
by Government this year?
 New fertilizer policy New fertilizer policy
*42. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government's  new fertilizer policy to
remove anomalies in the 2003 pricing
strategy is caught in the web of red tape;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
delay in announcing the new policy is
virtually choking the operations of some
public sector companies like Fertilizers and
Chemicals Travancore Limited (FACT)
and Madras Fertilizers Limited (MFL); and
(c) if so, the reasons for delay in
announcing new policy?
 Female foeticide and sex selective Female foeticide and sex selective
abortions in Himachal Pradeshabortions in Himachal Pradesh
*43. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
female foeticide and sex selective abortions
are common in Himachal Pradesh;
(b) whether the National Commission
for Women has called for a thorough check
on the use of ultrasound techniques in the
State; and
(c) what is the response of the State
Government to the problem?

*44. SHRI T.T.V.  DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of projects pending with
Government  for environmental clearance,
State-wise;
(b) the reason for undue delay in clearing
the projects; and
(c) whether Government  would set up
a time-frame for clearance of the projects

 Reforms in FPI sector of Karnataka Reforms in FPI sector of Karnataka
*45. SHRIMATI PREMA CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
initiate reforms in the food processing
sector in various States, particularly in
Karnataka;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of the incentives being
provided/proposed to be provided to the
food processing industries in Karnataka?
 Illegal kidney transplant Illegal kidney transplant
*46. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many cases
of illegal transplant of kidney in
Government and private hospitals have
come to light during current year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the action taken against the erring
doctors, middlemen and hospitals; and
(d) whether there is a provision in the
law to compensate the innocent donor
duped into parting with a kidney, for a
minimum six figure  amount in rupees, from
out of the fines/penalties levied on the
doctors/hospitals?

*47. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the sugar industry has
sought an overhaul of cane price regime
and to lower the statutory minimum cane
price (SMP) fixing  it on zonal basis linking
to average  and not peak recovery; and
(b) if so,  the reaction of Government to
the anomalies pointed out by the industry?

and gold worth crores of rupees from

 (c) whether it is also a fact that similar

thereof during last two years; and
(d) the action taken by Government
against the guilty?

Drought relief to Kerala
183. SHRI N. K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal received from
Government of Kerala seeking drought
relief assistance from NCCF is pending
with Government for sanction, if so, the
details thereof;
(b) whether Government assessed the
loss sustained by deputing central team; if
so, the loss ascertained; and
(c) whether Government consider to
release the assistance sought by the State
Government; if so, the details thereof and
if not, the reasons therefor?
Zero field from NDU-1 urad seeds
184. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
5,000 farmers across Uttar Pradesh were
supplied the wrong urad seeds for sowing
earlier this year;
(b) whether all the farmers who sowed
that seed called NDU-1 variety got zero
yield;
(c) whether the urad seeds for the Kharif
crop were supplied to farmers as Zayad
seeds;
(d) if so, whether Government have
done any investigations in this regard;
and
(e) if so, whether the affected farmers
would be given any compensation?
Promoting Organic seeds of Rajasthan
185. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Jhunjhunu district in Rajasthan will now
showcase its completely organic lentils,
tulsi and peas in food shelves across the
West;
(b) whether it is a fact that these
opportunities are opened up for the farmers
of the State, as the international agency
SGS  has inspected, tested and certified
them as organic products; and

43
(c) if so, how the Ministry proposes to
promote organic farming on a much larger
scale across India?
National Drought Policy
186. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
formulate a 'National Drought Policy' in
view of successive droughts in several parts
of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
MSP for Rabi Crops
187. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that this year
Government have announced the Minimum
Support Price (MSP)  for Rabi Crops well
before the arrival of farm produce in the
market; and
(b) if so, the reasons for such departure
from usual practice of announcing the MSP
after the arrival of crops in the market?
Expansion of NCDC
188. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to expand National Co-operative
Development Corporation, in order to work
out a vibrant co-operative structure;
(b) if so, the details of the initiative; and
(c) what are the existing problems being
faced by this sector and the action plan of
Government to redress these issues?
Impact of global warming on rice
production
189. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  Government have taken
note of the recent findings that the global
warming has cut rice harvest by atleast
10 per cent whereas the rice production has
to rise by one  per cent every year;
(b) whether this trend will affect Indian
farmers; and
(c) the details of rice production in the
country during the last five years, year-wise
and State-wise?
Expansion of KVKs in States
190. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
expand Krishi Vigyan Kendras in States,
in view of giving priority to agriculture
sector under common minimum
programme of Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the names of the States, where
expansion is proposed and whether Andhra
Pradesh is also among them?
Agricultural credit and farm produce
prices
191. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) in view of the categorical statement
of the Prime Minister that concrete steps
were being taken to address the problems
of agricultural credit and farm produce
prices, whether any modalities have been
evolved to achieve this objective;

44
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any monitoring mechanism
has been established to keep a watch on
the progress; and
(d) if so, the periodicity thereof?
Constitution of Expert Committee on
Agricultural Commission
192. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of

(a) whether Government  propose to
constitute an Expert Committee on
Agricultural Commissi
